blocks.title: Hybrid cloud
blocks.text: Hybrid cloud public aur private clouds ko milati aur data aur applications ko un ke darmiyan aane jane deti hai, jis se zyada lachak aur control milta hai.
Company rozmarra kaam public cloud par aur hassas data private cloud mein rakh sakti hai; masroof waqt mein kam hassas kaam public cloud par le jati jabke aham data private rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa model public aur private cloud ki khasusiyat milata hai (MCQ 6)? Kaunsa mushtarak maqasid wale idaron mein bata hota hai (MCQ 2)?
blocks.explanation: (b) hybrid cloud. (c) community cloud: kai mushtarak maqasid wale idaron, jaise hospitals ya sarkari mahkamon, ki mushtarak cloud; chapter ise bayan nahi karta, to yeh tareef aam ilm hai.

items: Hybrid cloud: rozmarra aur izafi kaam ke liye public, hassas data ke liye private.
